statements.subject: server
statements.description: When no Terminate-Reason 'time' parameter is included in a REDIRECT request, the client SHALL perform the redirection immediately and return a response to the server. The server shall consider the session to be terminated and can free any associated state after it receives the successful (2xx) response.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MAY close the signaling connection upon receiving the response, and the client SHOULD close the signaling connection after sending the 2xx response.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the REDIRECT request times out following the rules in Section 10.4, the server MAY terminate the session or transport connection that would be redirected by the request.
actions: server terminates session or transport connection

statements.subject: client
statements.description: After a REDIRECT request has been processed, a client that wants to continue to receive media for the resource identified by the Request-URI will have to establish a new session with the designated host. If the URI given in the Location header is a valid resource URI, a client SHOULD issue a DESCRIBE request for the URI.
statements.trigger: REDIRECT processed, Location contains valid resource URI
actions: client issues DESCRIBE request for Location URI
client establishes new session with designated host

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A server that needs to terminate a session or all its sessions and lacks an alternative server to redirect to, SHALL instead use TEARDOWN requests.
statements.trigger: server must terminate session(s), no alternative server available

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The server MAY simply cease to provide service when the deadline time has been reached, or it can issue a TEARDOWN request to the remaining sessions.
actions: server issues TEARDOWN to remaining sessions

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Any intervening proxies SHOULD do all of the following in the order listed: 1. respond to the REDIRECT request, 2. disconnect the control channel from the requesting server, 3. connect to the server at the given host address, 4. pass the REDIRECT request to each applicable client.
statements.trigger: REDIRECT without Session header received at proxy
actions: proxy disconnects control channel from requesting server
proxy connects to new server at given host address
proxy passes REDIRECT to each applicable client

statements.subject: session
statements.description: A client may receive a REDIRECT request with a Session header, if and only if, an end-to-end session has been established.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The REDIRECT request SHALL contain a Terminate-Reason header (Section 18.52) to inform the client of the reason for the request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: A REDIRECT request with a Session header... The REQUIRED Location header MUST contain a complete absolute URI pointing to the resource to which the client SHOULD reconnect.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client should have terminated the session and closed the connection before the redirection time-line terminated.
